joint: 1.5 mm mild foot butts the brow skin's outer corner. A shelf and a leg butt the tunnel skin's outer corner, 0.6 mm under the foot. Liner gap stays 2 mm. Skin opens 16 mm along the plate. No bolts.
grate: Rods on the upper rails, 32 mm above the deep-fire rails. Lift the hearth off and it is a grill.
grip: Jarrah grip on the brow, stainless ferrule, 0.15 mm radial press. The tunnel keeps its own grip.
etch: Inside the brow: 300 is the deck. 550 is the ceiling.
solver: SLSQP reaches 30.1 kg only by sitting on soffit 105 mm and skin 55°C. Shop keeps soffit 110 mm and 22 mm board.
note: Morghul gauges. The brow drops onto the shelf. The pit cooks without the hearth.
